integrity: Analytic proof with independent finite numerical checks as supplementary support; no exhaustive computational certification and no independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Even cyclic orders; two modulation channels, all translations, positive powers summing to two, and positive strictly decreasing radial Fourier energy. The graph heat specialization uses the directed-neighbor cycle Laplacian, including the doubled neighbor at order two. No odd-cycle, multi-channel, nonmonotone-profile, noise-inversion or global unrestricted-design conclusion; a possible equivalent classical circular-rearrangement lemma remains an originality risk.
title: Universal antipodal two-channel Fourier-frame optimality and sharp cyclic heat bounds
